works.title: Plato's Critique of Democracy: Trump as the Illustrative Tyrant
works.description: A reimagining of Plato's critique of democracy written in Plato's own voice, speaking directly to the present day with full awareness of contemporary politics. Trump serves as the emblematic example of the tyrant Plato warned could emerge from democratic excess—a leader who appeals through flattery and resentment rather than philosophy or knowledge.
works.quote: In your day this figure has taken the form of Donald Trump. He is not guided by philosophy, nor by knowledge, nor even by prudence, but only by appetite
